unreleased.summary: Work in progress — not yet released. Brand themes extracted from the DS, glassmorphism tokens, and SSR gaps resolved.
unreleased.h1: OrigamCode — compact and prompt display modes; two-axis theming (data-theme × data-mode) support
unreleased.h2: backdrop-filter glassmorphism tokens on Card / Sheet / Toolbar / Menu
unreleased.h3: Brand themes removed from the DS (ADR-004) — now installed via createOrigam() with a themes option instead of bundled in the lib
unreleased.h4: OrigamImg — markBooted rAF guard behind IN_BROWSER (SSR crash fixed)
unreleased.h5: Six SSR/theming gaps resolved: theme cookie race, data-mode on first SSR render, hydration mismatch on theme toggle

v260.summary: The bracket + a11y + theming release. v-contrast directive, OrigamBracket double-elimination, two-axis theming engine, monorepo migration. 170 commits.
v260.h1: v-contrast directive — runtime WCAG 2.1 AA text-legibility guard applied to every colour-bearing component
v260.h2: OrigamBracket — full double-elimination layout, Grand Final, cross-cutting prop surface, status indicators
v260.h3: OrigamBlockquote — two-axis colour model (color + bgColor) on all 5 variants
v260.h4: Two-axis theming engine — data-theme (brand identity) × data-mode (light/dark) + semantic JSON authoring
v260.h5: useStateEffect repaired — runtime prop changes for color/bgColor were silently ignored after initial mount
v260.h6: Monorepo migration — packages/ds, marketing, stories, docs, tests, figma-plugin as pnpm workspace packages

v251.summary: Patch. Two housekeeping commits with no public API impact.
v251.h1: Repository structure cleaned up — unit specs moved to tests/TU/, dev playground dropped

v250.summary: The accessibility release. WCAG 2.1 AA pass across the entire component catalogue. 35 targeted fixes across 36 components.
v250.h1: WCAG 2.1 AA pass — 35 fixes: missing aria-label, incorrect role, focus gaps, colour-contrast warnings, keyboard-navigation holes
v250.h2: OrigamSelect — full combobox ARIA pattern (role=combobox + aria-expanded + aria-activedescendant)
v250.h3: OrigamDataTable — caption element added; OrigamColorPicker — keyboard navigation restored
v250.h4: VitePress docs sidebar reorganised by UI taxonomy (layout / navigation / data-display / forms / feedback / utility)

v240.summary: The chart engine + media kit + Wave 4 release. 27 chart primitives, atomic media kit (OrigamAudio + OrigamVideo), 6 utility components, OrigamCalendar, gradient support. 149 commits.
v240.h1: OrigamChart + useChart — in-house chart engine. 8 base types, pure SVG, 19 chart families total, zero external dep
v240.h2: OrigamAudio + OrigamVideo — custom players with Media Session API, waveform, stem-tracks, WebVTT captions, zero external dep
v240.h3: OrigamGrid, OrigamMasonry, OrigamEmptyState, OrigamClipboard, OrigamInlineEdit, OrigamNumberFormat — Wave 4 utilities
v240.h4: OrigamCalendar — 4 views, RRULE recurring events, drag-to-create, keyboard navigation; OrigamTextMask + gradient color props
v240.h5: DS-wide reuse-interfaces audit — every component now extends IDimensionProps / IMarginProps / etc.
v240.h6: withDefaults() inline literal rule enforced — Grid, Masonry, Blockquote undefined prop crashes fixed

v230.summary: The features release. Four new components, official Nuxt module, SSR safety audit. 378 unit tests. 0 lint errors.
v230.h1: origam/nuxt — official Nuxt 3 / Nuxt 4 module with SSR-safe theme resolution, auto-imports, FOUC-free
v230.h2: OrigamTextField mask prop — built-in patterns (phone, IBAN, credit card, date…) + custom syntax, zero external dep
v230.h3: OrigamTextareaField mode=rich — lightweight HTML/Markdown editor, 9 toolbar commands, zero external dep
v230.h4: SSR safety audit — every composable and component confirmed SSR-safe or patched; new ssr-smoke.spec.ts

v221.summary: Patch. First version published to npm (2.2.0 was tagged but never published). One package.json exports fix.
v221.h1: Expose ./package.json explicitly in the exports map — consumer pattern reading the version was broken
v221.h2: 2.2.0 was tagged but never published to npm — 2.2.1 is the first version on the registry

v220.summary: The ready-for-npm release. Package metadata, peer dependencies, tree-shaking signals, README. Tarball shrunk from 5.6 MB to 867.9 kB. No API change vs 2.1.0.
v220.h1: 525+ missing Slot / Emit Variants across 113 stories; OrigamSwitchTrack extracted as a standalone primitive
v220.h2: peerDependencies (vue ^3.5, vue-i18n ^11, vue-router ^4.5) — no longer auto-installed as dependencies
v220.h3: Carousel progress prop wired to real cycle timer; Histoire sash resizes in both directions

v210.summary: The classes-first release. 13 transversal composables now emit utility classes for tokenised values. The inline-style stack on a typical button drops from ~12 to ~6 declarations.
v210.h1: 66 utility classes generated by Style Dictionary — origam--bg-[intent], origam--shadow-[rung], origam--rounded-[size]…
v210.h2: New *Classes return keys on all 10 transversal composables — colorClasses, elevationClasses, roundedClasses…
v210.h3: ~54 components migrated to consume *Classes in parallel with *Styles (transition strategy A)
v210.h4: OrigamSwitch thumb tinting restored — regression from OrigamSwitchTrack extraction fixed via classes-first

v200.summary: The design tokens release. Every component now resolves colors, spacing, typography and motion through a centralised, theme-aware token pipeline. 50+ components migrated.
v200.h1: Multi-tier design tokens — Primitive / Semantic / Component tiers; Style Dictionary v4 + Tokens Studio pipeline
v200.h2: Multi-theme runtime — useTheme() composable, OrigamThemeProvider, prefers-color-scheme fallback
v200.h3: CSS-first / JS-fallback principle — useCssSupport() composable wrapping CSS.supports() with 20 feature flags
v200.h4: Multiple critical bug fixes — OrigamMessages id binding, OrigamNumberField reactive loop, OrigamOtpInputField crash

meta.title: Figma plugin · origam design system
meta.description: Sync origam design tokens and components into Figma. Install the Origam DS Sync plugin via its manifest and keep your Figma file in sync with the token layer.

hero.subtitle: Origam DS Sync is a Figma plugin that generates 14 ComponentSets bound to your design tokens, and exports them back to the repo as Tokens Studio JSON or SCSS — keeping designers and developers in perfect sync.

install.subtitle: Origam DS Sync is a development plugin — it is not published to the Figma Community. You install it locally by importing its manifest.json in Figma desktop.
install.desktop_note: Figma desktop app required — the browser version cannot load local manifests.

download.title: 1. Download the plugin
download.description: Download the zip archive containing the plugin manifest and built artefacts (dist/code.js + dist/ui.html).

unzip.title: 2. Unzip the archive
unzip.description: Extract the zip to a permanent location on your machine. Figma reads the manifest from disk — do not move the folder after importing.

menu.title: 3. Open Figma desktop → Plugins → Development
menu.description: Open any Figma file in the desktop app. In the top menu, go to Plugins → Development → Import plugin from manifest…

manifest.title: 4. Select manifest.json
manifest.description: In the file picker that opens, navigate to the unzipped folder and select manifest.json. Figma registers the plugin immediately.

run.title: 5. Run Origam DS Sync
run.description: Go to Plugins → Development → Origam DS Sync. The plugin opens with three tabs: Generate (create ComponentSets), Export (Tokens Studio JSON or SCSS), and Sync (v2 placeholder).

cta.title: Ready to sync?
cta.description: Download the plugin, explore the source, or browse the origam component catalogue to see what gets generated.

wave4.blockquote: OrigamBlockquote — typography: quote + author + source + variants
wave4.empty_state: OrigamEmptyState — 5 presets: no-data, no-results, error, offline, locked

phases.title: A phased roadmap.
phases.subtitle: Each phase builds on the previous. The order reflects real technical dependencies, not arbitrary milestones.

ci.title: Complete CI / CD pipeline
ci.description: GitHub Actions: lint, token:lint, unit tests, e2e, build on every PR. Automated publish on tag v*.

deployment.title: Deploy VitePress + Histoire
deployment.description: Docs on origam.dev, stories on stories.origam.dev. Blocks all external adoption.

playwright.title: Full Playwright coverage
playwright.description: 100 % of public components covered — one spec per component exercising every Variant and prop.

a11y_audit.title: Overlay a11y audit
a11y_audit.description: Focus trap, focus restoration, aria-modal, Esc key for Dialog, Menu, Tooltip, Drawer, Snackbar.

bundle_size.title: Bundle-size monitoring
bundle_size.description: size-limit on every sub-export. PR comments auto-generated. The 5.6 MB → 869 kB drop must stay an asset.

tu_audit.title: Unit test suite consolidation
tu_audit.description: Standardize on a single tests/unit/{Domain}/{name}.spec.ts convention and lift branch coverage on the transversal composables, mocking CSS.supports in jsdom.

api_audit.title: Pre-v3 API audit
api_audit.description: A full deprecation inventory in the v2-to-v3 migration guide, missing {'@'}deprecated markers completed, and a codemod for the mechanical renames.

dependency_automation.title: Automated dependency updates
dependency_automation.description: Renovate with grouped update policies, automatic merges for patch-level dev dependencies, and a weekly grouped PR for minor bumps.

sonarqube.title: SonarQube — A rating, zero debt
sonarqube.description: The Sonar scan is already wired (build.yml + sonar-project.properties) but incomplete. Feed the Vitest lcov coverage into Sonar (sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths), enable a blocking quality gate, and clear every bug / vulnerability / security hotspot / code smell to reach an A rating on all axes with zero technical debt. Run on PRs and add it to the pre-delivery checks.

ci_e2e.title: CI E2E — job cancelled on every run
ci_e2e.description: The Playwright E2E job is cancelled on every CI run (the 5 other jobs pass): it exceeds its 30-min timeout even on the green subset. Cause: the Playwright webServer runs Histoire in Vite DEV mode, which compiles each story on first access (19-30 s cold-start per story) — too slow on a fresh runner. Decide: fix by pointing the e2e webServer at the static Histoire build already produced by build:embeds (public/stories, served via http-server — no Vite cold-start), or make the e2e job non-blocking / move it to a separate nightly workflow until then.

v3.title: v3.0.0 — Strategy B
v3.description: Remove *Styles returns when the value is tokenised. Utility classes become the sole API. ~2× less reactive computation.

modularization.title: Modular sub-exports (origam/core, origam/form, origam/chart, …)
modularization.description: Split the published library into tree-shakable sub-exports by domain, so an app only pays for what it actually imports. The existing origam barrel stays available for backward compatibility.

motion_tokens.title: Motion & a11y media tokens
motion_tokens.description: tokens/semantic/motion.json — durations, easings. Auto 0ms if prefers-reduced-motion. High-contrast ramp.

vrt.title: Visual regression testing
vrt.description: Playwright toHaveScreenshot() per Variant, or Chromatic / Lost-Pixel. Baseline on main, diff blocks PR.

accent_color.title: accentColor rename (breaking v3)
accent_color.description: bgColor → accentColor prop rename, aligned with the CSS accent-color standard. Full deprecation path included.

list_semantics.title: Semantic list variants (OrigamList)
list_semantics.description: OrigamList / OrigamListItem render div role="listbox" today. A new variant prop (unordered → ul/li, ordered → ol/li, nav, listbox) will emit real ul/ol/li semantics, replacing the boolean nav prop.

turborepo.title: Turborepo build cache
turborepo.description: Replace raw pnpm -r scripts with Turborepo pipelines. Remote cache drastically cuts CI rebuild time.

variant_presets.title: variant as a preset of real props
variant_presets.description: Turn each visual variant into a transparent, fully overridable preset of component props instead of hardcoded styling — piloted on OrigamBlockquote, then generalized.

add_more.title: OrigamAddMore — form field repeater
add_more.description: A new form component for repeating a group of fields with an 'Add more' action, min/max bounds, and full keyboard and screen-reader support.

content_justify.title: OrigamBtn — contentJustify prop
content_justify.description: A props-first way to control how a button's content aligns inside its layout, for buttons that don't rely on the prepend/append icon slots.

background_directive.title: v-background directive
background_directive.description: Compose one or several backgrounds on any element — image or color gradient (tokenised intents + custom). Per-layer position, size, repeat and a simple mask. Each layer renders as a pseudo-element (default, zero extra DOM) or an injected div, switchable in the directive config.

textmask_stroke.title: TextMask — colored stroke & fill
textmask_stroke.description: Extend OrigamTextMask with an outlined mode: transparent text with a colored per-letter stroke (-webkit-text-stroke) and/or a distinct fill, for outline-only and contrasted headline effects. Stays real, selectable text; CSS-first with a solid fallback.

theming_completion.title: Complete the /theming builder
theming_completion.description: The marketing theme builder shipped as a partial V1 (~14 core components, tokens capped, modals/slot-driven not previewable). Finish it: cover all editable components, handle overlay/slot-driven previews, lift the token cap, and rework the UI — the current ergonomics are clearly not good enough. Stays data-driven and DS-first.

wizard_form.title: OrigamWizardForm — multi-step form
wizard_form.description: Composes the existing OrigamForm and OrigamStepper — no reimplementation of validation or step navigation. Per-step validation blocks progression until the active step is valid; a single v-model aggregates every step's values.

page.title: OrigamPage — page wrapper
page.description: A deliberately simple structural wrapper with three optional zones — header, content, footer — rendered as real semantic elements. No imposed scroll or sticky behaviour, just a consistent page skeleton on top of the DS spacing tokens.

section.title: OrigamSection — section schemas
section.description: OrigamSection exists today as an empty 14-line shell — this finishes it, it is not a new component. Reuses the schema pattern already proven by OrigamSkeleton: predefined section schemas such as hero, split, centered or full-bleed, as overridable prop presets on a real section element, props-first.

vapor.title: Vue Vapor mode (exploratory)
vapor.description: No-virtual-DOM compilation — ~40 % less runtime overhead. POC on 5 pivot components, benchmarks first.

web_components.title: Web Components export
web_components.description: origam/elements sub-export via defineCustomElement. Cross-framework demo (React, Svelte, Angular).

theme_builder.title: Theme Builder UI
theme_builder.description: Standalone app consuming origam itself: edit primitive tokens, preview components in real time, export brand JSON.

marketing_db.title: Marketing — database + auto DS sync
marketing_db.description: Persist the whole reference catalogue (components, composables, types, enums, interfaces, utils, consts) in a database (Nitro + TypeORM / PostgreSQL) instead of static glob files. A sync job reads the DS source and upserts the DB on every release, so the reference docs follow the design system automatically. Editorial content lives in the same tables with a DS-auto vs edited flag.

marketing_cms.title: Marketing — admin backend (CMS)
marketing_cms.description: A back-office to manage all site content when auto-generation falls short: edit any page (reference + editorial), reorder, publish/hide, without touching code. Fully translatable (DB-driven i18n, per-locale completeness) and built with origam itself — a full-scale DS showcase. Auth + roles, change audit, pre-publish guardrail. Stack: Nitro + TypeORM/PostgreSQL + Redis.

server_components.title: Vue Server Components
server_components.description: Track the Vue compiler ecosystem and align with a React-Server-Components-style pattern once it stabilizes.

ai_figma.title: AI-assisted generation (Figma → code)
ai_figma.description: Make the Figma plugin bidirectional — turning Figma designs into origam components automatically speeds up new component creation.

maintenance_eol.title: Maintenance & EOL policy
maintenance_eol.description: A documented LTS policy: after v3.0 ships, the v2.x branch keeps receiving security and critical bugfixes for a defined window.

dependencies.title: Dependency hygiene
dependencies.description: Weekly automated dependency updates; zero high or critical vulnerability tolerated at merge time.

doc.title: Documentation coverage
doc.description: No component merges without its doc page. Quarterly audit of the documentation links.

performance.title: Performance budget
performance.description: Bundle-size checks block any PR that exceeds its budget; every changed component is profiled before merge.

refactor.title: Boy-scout refactors
refactor.description: Any PR touching a component with legacy patterns (hardcoded colors, inline-only styling) migrates it before merge.

quality_gate.title: Code-quality gate
quality_gate.description: Static analysis, strict linting, and type-checking run on every PR — no unexplained escape hatches.

changelog.title: Changelog discipline
changelog.description: The changelog is updated with every pull request, not just at release time.

test_as_you_build.title: Test-as-you-build
test_as_you_build.description: Every new story ships with its end-to-end coverage in the same pull request — checked automatically in CI.

security.title: Security checks on every PR
security.description: Secret scanning on every pull request, plus a dedicated security review for any change to server code, services, or build configuration.

cta.title: Follow the progress.
cta.description: Star the repository on GitHub to stay updated. Contributions and feedback are welcome.

wave4_grid.subtitle: Everything in Wave 4 is live on npm. These are the components and features available right now in origam.

empty_state.name: OrigamEmptyState
empty_state.note: 5 presets: no-data, no-results, error, offline, locked

clipboard.name: OrigamClipboard
clipboard.note: Copy wrapper + Copied! feedback, no dependencies

inline_edit.name: OrigamInlineEdit
inline_edit.note: Edit-in-place pattern, v-model + validators, ARIA live

number_format.name: OrigamNumberFormat
number_format.note: i18n formatting via Intl.NumberFormat, display only

qr_code.name: OrigamQRCode
qr_code.note: SVG output, ISO/IEC 18004, error correction level, logo overlay

watermark.name: OrigamWatermark
watermark.note: Diagonal repeat overlay, SVG text or canvas data-URI

video.name: OrigamVideo
video.note: Custom player: play/pause, scrubber, PIP, captions, HLS optional

sound.name: OrigamSound
sound.note: Audio player + waveform via Web Audio API, Media Session API

chart.name: OrigamChart
chart.note: SVG-native: line, area, bar, pie, radar, scatter — no d3 or chart.js

gradient.name: Gradient support
gradient.note: color/bgColor/textColor props now accept gradient values

text_mask.name: OrigamTextMask
text_mask.note: Text reveal via background-clip: text, gradient + image backgrounds

meta.title: Support origam · Vue 3 design system
meta.description: origam is free and MIT-licensed, maintained by one developer. Donations fund the maintenance work.

hero.title: Support origam
hero.lead: origam is built and maintained by one developer, on his own time. It is free, MIT-licensed, and it will stay that way. If it saves you time, a donation keeps it moving.

give.title: Make a donation
give.hint: Scan the code with your phone, or use the button below. Payments are handled by PayPal — no account is required to give by card.

what.title: What it changes
what.body: Donations buy maintenance time: answering issues, keeping dependencies patched, testing across browsers, and writing the documentation that makes a component usable rather than merely shipped. They are not a support contract and they buy no priority — they simply make the unglamorous work sustainable.
what.alt: Not in a position to give? Reporting a precise bug, improving a documentation page or telling someone about origam helps just as much.

meta.title: Why origam? · Vue 3 design system
meta.description: An honest look at what origam is, what makes it different, and when you should — or shouldn't — choose it.

hero.subtitle: We built origam for Vue 3 teams who care about design quality, accessibility, and token-driven consistency. Here's what we do well — and where we're still growing.

strengths.title: Built for Vue 3. From the ground up.
strengths.subtitle: Every API, every composable, every prop — designed for Composition API and TypeScript from day one.

vue3.title: Vue 3 native
vue3.description: Built with Composition API and script setup. No legacy Options API shim, no Vue 2 baggage — just clean, idiomatic Vue 3.

tokens.title: Design tokens DTCG
tokens.description: Tokens Studio-compatible, Style Dictionary v4. 8 themes switch at runtime with zero remount and zero flicker.

charts.title: 95 components + 29 chart primitives
charts.description: From atomic buttons to line, area, donut, heatmap and candlestick charts — all in one coherent package.

a11y.title: WCAG 2.1 AA verified
a11y.description: axe-core + Playwright a11y tests ship with every component. Keyboard, screen-readers and reduced-motion: covered.

css.title: CSS-first architecture
css.description: Container queries, :has(), color-mix(), view-transition-name. We use the platform so your bundle doesn't pay for polyfills.

treeshake.title: < 50 kb tree-shakable
treeshake.description: ESM-first build. Import what you use; the rest never reaches your users.

composables.title: Headless composables
composables.description: Every component exposes its logic as a standalone composable. Use our UI or build your own on top of our primitives.

mit.title: MIT licensed
mit.description: No license fees, no usage restrictions. origam is and will remain open source.

comparison.title: How does origam compare?
comparison.subtitle: A feature-by-feature look at the Vue ecosystem's main design systems. Assessments are our own and may be out of date — always verify against the project's current docs.
comparison.disclaimer: Some assessments reflect our interpretation of publicly available documentation. Competitors ship fast — check their docs.
comparison.vuetify_note: Mature Material Design system, large community and ecosystem.
comparison.prime_vue_note: Very large component count, has its own token system (PrimeFlex).
comparison.quasar_note: Full multi-platform framework (web, Cordova, Electron). Different scope.
comparison.element_plus_note: Popular in the Chinese developer community, wide component coverage.
comparison.naive_ui_note: TypeScript-first, theme customisation via JS, lightweight.

weaknesses.title: Where we're still growing.
weaknesses.subtitle: origam is young. That's a strength in terms of API freshness — and a constraint in terms of maturity.

community.title: Smaller community
community.description: Vuetify and PrimeVue have years of production usage, thousands of Stack Overflow answers, and rich third-party template markets. origam doesn't — yet.

templates.title: Fewer ready-made templates
templates.description: You won't find dozens of admin dashboards or landing-page kits built on origam today. You build with the primitives.

scale.title: Less battle-tested at scale
scale.description: We haven't been stress-tested in apps with hundreds of devs and millions of daily users. If that's your situation, factor this in.

use_cases.title: Pick origam when…
use_cases.no_fits_title: origam might not be the right call

greenfield.title: Greenfield Vue 3 project
greenfield.description: Starting fresh on Vue 3 with a design team that works in Figma and tokens? origam is built for this exact setup.

token_team.title: Design-token-driven team
token_team.description: If your designer uses Tokens Studio or Style Dictionary, origam integrates natively — no translation layer needed.

saas_product.title: SaaS / product requiring multiple brand themes
saas_product.description: Need to ship the same app in client-A colours and client-B colours? Multi-theme at runtime is a first-class feature.

dataviz.title: Data-heavy UI with charts
dataviz.description: 29 chart primitives — line, area, bar, donut, heatmap, candlestick — themed and accessible, in one install.

migration.title: Migrating a large Vuetify 2 codebase
migration.description: If you have thousands of Vuetify components to migrate, Vuetify 3 will be a lower-friction path than origam.

ecosystem.title: Needing a large third-party template market
ecosystem.description: If you rely on pre-built admin themes or marketplace templates, Vuetify or PrimeVue have a larger catalogue today.

cta.title: Ready to try it?
cta.description: Install origam in 30 seconds and see how far the defaults take you.
